PDF content-mismatch bug (Penawaran vs Kwitansi single download AND bulk ZIP) is CONFIRMED FIXED. Theme palette (120 swatches, 5 groups HITAM/PUTIH/BIRU/KUNING/MERAH) renders correctly, click updates accent, and persists across reload. ui_bugs.issue: Clicking or hovering [data-testid="mega-menu-trigger"] does NOT open the mega menu panel. Root cause: index.php has TWO elements sharing data-testid="mega-menu-item" (the outer <nav class="main-nav"> at line 27 AND the inner <div class="nav-item"> at line 28). In assets/js/homepage.js the code `var navItem = document.querySelector('[data-testid="mega-menu-item"]')` grabs the FIRST match = the <nav>. So openMenu()/click-toggle adds `menu-open` to <nav>, but the CSS rule that reveals the panel is `.nav-item.menu-open .mega-menu {opacity:1;visibility:visible;...}` (homepage.css line 26) which requires the class on the inner .nav-item. Result: panel stays opacity:0 visibility:hidden forever. Verified by evaluating computed styles after hover: {panelVisibility:'hidden', panelOpacity:'0'}, and by manually adding `menu-open` to the inner .nav-item in devtools which makes the panel appear. All 6 outlet taglines (Jembatan Aspirasi / Pemersatu Banua / Sarabakawa / Tergores / Dunia Dalam Genggaman / Bahalap) ARE present in the rendered HTML — this is purely a JS-selector-vs-CSS mismatch. Fix: either remove data-testid="mega-menu-item" from the outer <nav> (keep only on .nav-item), OR change the JS selector to `.nav-item[data-testid="mega-menu-item"]` / `document.querySelectorAll(...)[1]`.

Duplicate data-testid="mega-menu-item" on two different elements (<nav> and <div class="nav-item">) in /app/efiling-app/index.php lines 27 & 28. Testability antipattern and the direct cause of the mega-menu bug above.

action_items: FIX HIGH: /app/efiling-app/index.php lines 27-28 — remove data-testid="mega-menu-item" from the outer <nav class="main-nav"> (keep it only on the inner <div class="nav-item">). This single change will make the mega menu open correctly on hover AND click, because the JS querySelector will then match the correct .nav-item element that the CSS is scoped to. Alternatively, change assets/js/homepage.js line 3 to `var navItem = document.querySelector('.nav-item[data-testid="mega-menu-item"]')`.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testid on two different DOM elements (index.php L27 & L28) violates testability best-practice: each data-testid must be unique. This directly caused the mega-menu bug.

In assets/js/homepage.js the mega-menu click handler toggles menu-open on the same element that mouseenter/mouseleave manage, causing a subtle UX quirk: a click while hovered will CLOSE (toggle off) the just-opened menu. Consider using explicit open()/close() logic rather than toggle().
homepage.js openMenu() has a 150ms mouseleave grace but no keyboard focus support (Enter/Space on the trigger button opens via click handler, but Esc doesn't close the menu). Minor a11y polish.

Overlay z-index in mobile drawer (90) vs drawer (100) is correct, but on the drawer-overlay is a full-viewport element — clicking overlay at coordinates covered by the drawer visually would not close it. Not a functional bug (a tap outside the drawer works), just be aware for future e2e testers.

rca of the issue: Mega menu bug RCA — Reproduction: 1) Load http://127.0.0.1:8090/ at 1920x1080. 2) Hover or click 'Media Kami' nav item ([data-testid=mega-menu-trigger]). 3) Expected: [data-testid=mega-menu-panel] becomes visible with 6 outlet chips + taglines. Actual: panel remains hidden (computed visibility:hidden, opacity:0). Root cause: index.php lines 27-28 assign the same data-testid="mega-menu-item" to two nested elements (<nav class="main-nav"> and <div class="nav-item">). homepage.js selects only the FIRST via querySelector, which is the outer <nav>, and toggles menu-open on it. But homepage.css line 26 targets `.nav-item.menu-open .mega-menu` — the class needs to be on the INNER .nav-item. Mitigation: remove the redundant data-testid from the outer <nav>, or change the JS to select the .nav-item explicitly.
